# kion_oauth2_client (Resource)

Manages a Kion OAuth2 client. Requires Kion 3.17.3 or later. Updating a dynamically registered client through Terraform permanently converts it to a manually managed client and revokes its registration access token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_oauth2_client" "example" {
  # Required
  grant_types = []
  name        = "example"

  # Optional
  # allowed_scopes          = []
  # description             = "example"
  # is_public               = false
  # owner_user_id           = 1
  # redirect_uris           = []
  # service_account_user_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `grant_types` (List of String) Allowed grant types.
- `name` (String) Name of the OAuth client.

### Optional

- `allowed_scopes` (List of String) Kion product scopes this client may request. Supported values are "mcp" and "api".
An empty list grants no Kion product access.
- `description` (String) Description of the OAuth client.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the client is public (no secret). Changing it replaces the client, which issues a new secret.
- `owner_user_id` (Number) Owner of the client. Omitted from configuration, the current owner is kept; Kion makes a client with no owner a global application.
- `redirect_uris` (List of String) Allowed redirect URIs.
- `service_account_user_id` (Number) Service account user ID for client_credentials grant.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) OAuth Client ID.
- `is_dynamically_registered` (Boolean) Whether the client is managed with an RFC 7592 registration access token.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret. Returned only when the client is created, so it is null after import and for public clients.
